description: This file implements backend APIs for the COSA Data Model Library related to file transfer operations, including creation, initialization, and removal of file transfer objects.

methods.name: CosaFileTransferCreate
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new COSA FileTransfer object, returning its handle.

methods.name: CosaFileTransferInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the FileTransfer object with default configuration values.

methods.name: CosaFileTransferRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees the FileTransfer object.
